desc: For times in the field when you just can't reach your Otis cleaning system and need a quick and effective clean - reach for the Ripcord™. This convenient tool cleans from Breech-to-Muzzle® in one quick and easy pass. The molded rubberized core and Nomex® fibers together create a more effective way to trap and remove fouling. Available in .223 cal/5.56mm, .30 cal, 9mm, .40 cal & .45 cal.
